correctness.rationale: The specified polynomial has correct margins identically. Its density equals 1+a xy+b P2(x)P2(y). At opposite-sign corners and axis points one obtains -1<=b<=2; minimization of Q_b=(1+bP2(s)P2(t))/(st) over s,t>0 by w=st and R=s/t+t/s yields the exact two-piece H(b) and the b=2 limiting case. Independent exact polynomial integration of C and C*dC verifies rho=a/3 and tau=2a(b+25)/225, and differentiating H(b)(1+b/25) gives b*=(sqrt(171)-11)/2, with both endpoints checked. Finite probes are not used as proof of continuous positivity.
